name: orbiting-circles
title: Orbiting Circles
description: Small badges travel on one or two thin circular orbits around a centre, staying upright as they go; the outer ring turns the other way, more slowly. Pointing at it stops the orbits.

meta.useWhen: A real centre with real satellites: a cooperative and its member farms, a studio and its long-term clients, a hub airport and its routes.
meta.avoidWhen: The generic "integrations around our logo" picture; more than about 10 satellites; anything the visitor must read while it moves (list them in text too).
